bifrost: springboard/src/shell/account.rs (one local account); springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs (credential store); springboard/sdk/src/dispatch.rs (async completions)
summary: Open Directory authenticates users and searches records (people, groups) in directory nodes such as LDAP servers. BifrOSt has one local account created by the installer, no directory node, no record query API and no directory authentication, so the directory client API is a gap. The contacts app and cloud sync are separate services and are not a directory counterpart.

features.apple: ODSession, ODSessionRef, ODNode, ODNodeRef, ODNodeCreateWithName, ODNodeCopySubnodeNames (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/opendirectory/opendirectory-functions)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 3 (w3-open-directory, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API connects to a directory server or lists its nodes.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (w3-open-directory, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Quick search indexes local app content; it does not query a directory.

features.feature: Directory records: read, write, group membership
features.apple: ODRecord, ODRecordRef, ODRecordCopyDetails, ODRecordSetValue, ODRecordAddMember, ODRecordDelete
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/account.rs (parse: full_name and username record fields)
features.note: The local account record is parsed, and its password rules are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: there is no record model for other people or groups and no write API. Built 2026-10-17: the local directory reads users and groups from /etc/passwd and /etc/group into a directory node (POSIX attribute names, members as memberUid), springboard/ui/src/directory_local.rs; tests there (fixtures, no live read). Gap: still read-only, no write API.

A salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password record with constant-time matching and a five-failure, sixty-second lock is tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-10.rs. Gap: the login screen still checks only the installer account, no directory holds the records, and no SDK call verifies or changes another account's password; those need the account store and the lab machine.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. Dispatch queues exist for apps; nothing feeds them directory results, so this row is partial only through the generic dispatch API.
Policies are enforced by a directory server for managed accounts. BifrOSt has no managed multi-user directory to apply them to.

features.feature: Contacts search in LDAP or Open Directory
features.apple: ODQuery against an LDAP node for contact attributes (framework summary)
features.note: Headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-03.rs: person records of a node are searched as contacts (name, addresses, phones; groups excluded; sorted and limited), and the same query is written as an RFC 4515 LDAP filter with user text escaped. Gap: no directory server client sends the filter or reads entries back, and the contacts app still searches only its local contacts; that needs a directory service on the lab machine.

gaps: LDAP directory nodes are read through ldapsearch (sdk ldap_directory.rs); there is no session object or node API for apps.
No directory-backed user lookup or sign-in; the local account directory (ui directory_local.rs) reads this machine only.
No SDK call to verify or change the password of another account.
Contacts app cannot search a directory server for people.
